content.text:
The first person pays £24 and the second pays £28.

The fee depends on the date the payment is received. The 16 June 2025 decision replaces film-fees.md 1.1. From 1 July 2025, annual adult membership costs £28 instead of £24, and payments received before 1 July 2025 keep the old fee (film-changes.md, section 1, items 1.2–1.4).

- **First person:** their payment was received on 30 June 2025, before 1 July, so the old £24 fee applies (film-fees.md, 1.1).
- **Second person:** their payment was received on 2 July 2025, after the change, so the fee is £28.
